customization.summary: Legacy system.ai.python_exec via SQL in the current adapter; not dedicated Sandbox or the new system.ai.sandbox MCP. Warehouse capacity is separately configurable, but built-in-function image/resources/dependencies are not requested.

features.notes: No image selector in the built-in-function invocation; general cluster image support is outside scope.
Historical report lists packages and pip --version, not installation. Custom dependency ENVIRONMENT clauses for separately defined UDFs do not prove python_exec customization.
SQL warehouse cluster size/concurrency configurable externally; no per-function vCPU allocation. Actual warehouse size absent from report.
Warehouse capacity can be sized; independent interpreter RAM selection unavailable in inspected request. PENDING after 50 seconds is not a measured RAM ceiling.
No selectable GPU in this SQL/function interface; other Databricks GPU services are not this provider.

No adapter policy control. Historical DNS allowed, HTTP/metadata probes blocked. New sandbox MCP explicitly has no egress; general UDF networking exists, so neither establishes a universal legacy configurable policy.
No durable disk/mount interface in adapter. Historical scratch disk writes succeeded, contradicting README's all-I/O-forbidden claim, but not proving persistence.
Independent statement submissions without interpreter session handle. Historical five-turn workload runs inside a single program.
Python-code function, no first-class command or SSH interface. New system.ai.sandbox shell capability is outside this adapter.
Adapter embeds lossy UTF-8 INPUT_FILES and returns no artifacts; it does not implement native file transport.
No preview or port interface in this built-in function invocation.
Managed Databricks-provided execution; open client libraries do not self-host the service.
No function-specific key guarantee verified. Adapter capability false is not a documented platform prohibition.

pricing.model: Applicable SQL warehouse/serverless compute SKU billed in DBUs; legacy functions MCP documented as serverless general compute. Model inference separate and absent from adapter.

rates.resource: External model inference if separately used

pricing.limitations: No universal rate extracted: official numeric pricing table rendered Loading; actual SKU/cloud/configuration and effective price period missing. list_prices documents exact usage units and effective dates. Report's $0.000025/second is an assumption, not current official pricing or invoice evidence. No comparable dated price-increase evidence.

tested_configuration.requested: Profile/warehouse selection; parameterized SELECT system.ai.python_exec(:code); no per-function resource/image/network config.
tested_configuration.limitations: Five current readiness/CPU/inventory trials pass after unconditional inventory output fix. Guest-visible 8 CPUs, Python3.12.3 and300MiB memory do not attest allocated warehouse resources. Reference MCP adapter differs. See tested-configurations.json; no billing export.
